tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background, and the inset well behind logs and inputs. Night is near-navy, never black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, legends and other contained groups that sit on `ground`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Default button fill and meter tracks: the one step up from `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: panel borders, row dividers, section-label rules, control borders at rest. Structure comes from hairlines, never shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and values on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata and timestamps on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (4.5:1 or better in both themes); also the hover border on controls.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: The headline and big figures (gauge and total values) only: one notch brighter than `ink`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one hue: primary buttons, links, and the good / healthy signal (status light, meter fill, success text). Text in `accent` reads on `ground` and `surface` in both themes; on `surface-raised` keep it to 19px bold or larger, or marks.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill (primary button): 4.8:1 at rest and 6.5:1 on `accent-hover` in Day, 10.5:1 in Night.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Needs attention but not action: caution status light, meter fill past its threshold, warning text on `ground` and `surface`. Also the focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset), which clears 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure or destruction: danger status light, failed rows, the outlined danger button. Text on `ground` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Danger button background on hover.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Cross-reference highlight: fills every occurrence of a hovered or pinned term, and the hint chip. Same pale yellow in both themes.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on a `highlight` fill.

tokens.name: glow-accent-color
tokens.usage: Halo colour behind a good status light.

tokens.name: glow-caution-color
tokens.usage: Halo colour behind a caution status light.

tokens.name: glow-danger-color
tokens.usage: Halo colour behind a danger status light.

tokens.name: glow-highlight-color
tokens.usage: Halo around a highlighted term.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The app's one headline, UPPERCASE, in `ink-strong`; a second word may drop to weight 500 in `ink-muted`. Scales fluidly from 1.9rem on phones.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Section and panel labels between hairline rules, UPPERCASE, `ink-muted`.

styles.name: stat-key
styles.usage: The key above a gauge figure, UPPERCASE, `ink-muted`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Credit refills after the morning's replacement; no action needed.
styles.usage: Default running text in `ink`. Cap prose at about 36rem inside panels.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Everything you run, on one page, by night or by day.
styles.usage: The intro line under the headline, `ink-muted`, max 44rem; bold words step up to `ink`.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Self-resolves in five to six hours.
styles.usage: Explanations inside panels: alert notes, empty states, all-clear lines.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Gauge and total values in `ink-strong`; the unit drops to 0.8rem `ink-muted`.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Identifiers, names and paths in lists and group heads.

styles.name: log
styles.usage: Streaming log lines in an inset well.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to control; key to figure.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a row; legend item to its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between columns of a list row; between section-label and its rules.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel top padding; gap between legend items.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel side and bottom padding; gap between gauges.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in the grid.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major sections of a page.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Highlighted terms.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Meter tracks and fills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, log wells, swatches, the hint chip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and legends. A panel with a top rule keeps its top corners square.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status lights.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill controls: the DataTable filter.

shadow.note: The only shadows are glows: coloured halos on status lights and highlighted terms. Panels never cast shadows.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Good status light at rest; breathes between 8px 1px and 13px 3px.

tokens.name: glow-caution
tokens.usage: Caution status light.

tokens.name: glow-danger
tokens.usage: Danger status light. Does not breathe: it holds still.

tokens.name: glow-highlight
tokens.usage: Highlighted term.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and divider, in `line`.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: The top rule on a group panel, in `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, solid `caution`, offset 2px.

tokens.name: light-size
tokens.usage: Status light diameter.

tokens.name: meter-height
tokens.usage: Meter track height; the threshold tick overhangs 3px each side.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Longest run of prose inside a panel.

tokens.name: breakpoint-stack
tokens.usage: Below this width, panel grids stack to one column and gauges go two-up.

tokens.name: breakpoint-wide
tokens.usage: From this width, half panels share a row on a six-column grid.
